def is_attacked(board, sq, by_color):
    # Check Knights
    knight_diffs = [17, 15, 10, 6, -6, -10, -15, -17]
    # Boundaries check needed to prevent wrap-around false positives
    # e.g. a3 to b1 is valid. a3 to h4?
    sq_file = sq % 8
    
    for diff in knight_diffs:
        target = sq + diff
        if 0 <= target < 64:
            # Valid move geometry?
            # Simple abs file diff check
            if abs((target % 8) - sq_file) <= 2:
                if board[target] == by_color * 2: # Knight
                    return True
    
    # Check Pawns
    if by_color == -1: # Black attacks
        # Black pawns are at sq + 7 or sq + 9
        for d in [7, 9]:
            target = sq + d
            if 0 <= target < 64:
                 if board[target] == -1: # Black Pawn
                     return True
    else: # White attacks
        for d in [-7, -9]:
            target = sq + d
            if 0 <= target < 64:
                if board[target] == 1: # White Pawn
                    return True
                    
    # Check King
    king_diffs = [1, -1, 8, -8, 9, -9, 7, -7]
    for d in king_diffs:
        target = sq + d
        if 0 <= target < 64:
             if abs((target % 8) - sq_file) <= 1: # King move distance check
                if board[target] == by_color * 6: # King
                    return True

    # Check Sliders
    # Rooks/Queens: +1, -1, +8, -8
    # Bishops/Queens: +9, -9, +7, -7
    dirs = [(1, 0), (-1, 0), (8, 0), (-8, 0), (9, 1), (-9, 1), (7, 1), (-7, 1)]

    # Actually we need specific directions
    # Ortho: 1, -1, 8, -8
    # Diag: 7, -7, 9, -9
    
    # Ortho (R, Q)
    for d in [1, -1, 8, -8]:
        cur = sq
        while True:
            prev_file = cur % 8
            cur += d
            if not (0 <= cur < 64): break
            # Wrap check
            if abs((cur % 8) - prev_file) > 1: break # Jumped across board edge
            
            piece = board[cur]
            if piece != 0:
                if piece * by_color > 0: # Enemy piece
                    pt = abs(piece)
                    if pt == 4 or pt == 5: # Rook or Queen
                        return True
                break # Blocked
    
    # Diag (B, Q)
